_about: Explain's checks after the model, before anything is spoken (backend/llm/natlas_guard.py): an answer naming a medicine, or using a dose word, is never spoken; the page is read instead. Medicine names are the same in every language; dose words are per language. In a dose word, N stands for a number: digits (4, 0.5), a number word of that language (content/number_words/) or a range ('4 to 6', '4-6'); a hyphen may be there or not ('4-hourly', '4 hourly').
